'''Pierre Macq''' (8 July 1930 in [[Ganshoren]] – 17 September 2013) was a [[Belgium|Belgian]] physicist who was the rector of the [[Université catholique de Louvain|University of Louvain]] (UCLouvain) from 1986 until 1995.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zoomregion.be/details.php?id_articles=7711 |title=Décès de Pierre Macq, premier recteur laïc de l'UCLouvain |publisher=Zoomregion.be |date= |access-date=19 September 2013}}</ref> In 1973, he was awarded the [[Francqui Prize]] on Exact Sciences for his work on experimental nuclear physics.

In 1991, the Hoover Chair was founded by Pierre Macq, at the Faculty of Economic, Social and Political sciences of the UCLouvain, thanks to a donation from the [[BAEF]] for university development.
